''[[The High Republic: Path of Deceit]]'' states that members of the [[Path of the Open Hand]] receive full membership at the age of fifteen, and also mentions that [[Marda Ro]] recently became a full member. As ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia]]'' dates the events of ''Path of Deceit'' to [[382 BBY]], Marda must have been [[Reproduction|born]] around [[397 BBY]]. The novel also establishes that [[Yana Ro]] had been considering leaving the Path for five [[Standard year|years]], meaning she must have been a member of the Path by [[387 BBY]]. Therefore, the [[escape from Genetia]] must have taken place between 397 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] and 387 BBY.<noinclude>
